meta.description: Analyzes differential transcript usage (DTU) and isoform switches with functional consequence prediction (NMD via the 50 nt rule, ORF disruption, domain loss/gain, coding-potential shifts; signal peptide and IDR changes when licensed annotators are available) using IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR, the manual DRIMSeq-DEXSeq/satuRn-stageR pipeline and fishpond/swish.
not_executed: tximeta rowData(se)$gene_id path on real tximeta output (linkedTxome does not match the Salmon 2.7.0 index; the Skill says so)
IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR releases newer than 2.6.0 (not installable in Bioc 3.20)
meta.data: SYNTHETIC planted-truth sets in run/data (synth seed 20260920, new1 seed 8801 4v7, new2 seed 8802 5v5) plus real nf-core rnasplice chrX GBR v YRI 2 v 2 (Salmon quants, Gibbs samples, BAM-derived GTF/FASTA) from audit-envs public-data.

scientific_integrity.detail: Numbers quoted in the Skill (26/20, 28/22, 0/0 route table; 13/13/2 and 11/11/7; 391/6; 0.96/1.00 NMD flag; 8/10 v 10/10) reproduced; two small figures differ (specificity 0.95 v 0.89, factor max 576 v 205 by effective length). Citations checked against Crossref/bioRxiv where possible; the preprint attribution is unverifiable from its abstract (P2).

practice_boundaries.detail: Research analysis only; no diagnosis or treatment advice; the SCN1A ASO is stated as 'in clinical development, phase not verified'.

methodological_ground.detail: No principled error: DTU separated from DGE/DTE, stageR two-stage, compositional null, replicate/covariate handling stated; n=2 caution is under-stated (P1) but not a fallacy.

code_usability.detail: All Skill blocks, the example (demo and real mode) and the converter executed from copies with checked output; every R block ran verbatim. Only licence-gated annotator calls were not run and are labelled so.

functional_suitability.note: Covers DTU/DTE/DGE framing, ISAR workflow, manual DRIMSeq/DEXSeq/stageR, swish, NMD and consequence annotation; every numeric claim checked reproduced except two small figures (post-analyzeORF specificity 0.89 v 0.95 measured; factor max 205 v 576). Attributes 'auto-selecting wrapper' to the 2025 preprint, whose abstract does not say so. Licence-gated annotators flagged unrun.

reliability.note: Common Errors table holds 14 real messages, all 14 re-triggered here and matching (one dmFilter message quoted without its first clause); hard stops and ID checks in block and example. The block's metadata check message names nothing; n=2 false-positive behaviour not warned.

performance_context.note: 491 lines / 37 KB in one SKILL.md with no references/; workflow itself is linear and the example/converter carry the heavy logic.

agent_usability.note: Clear DGE/DTE/DTU table, ordered consequence steps, checkpoints with numbers to expect, error text to expect; the count-route section needs a re-read.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger language; strict validation is by design; the one weak point is the opaque stopifnot message in the block.

security.note: No credentials, no eval/exec, local R/Python only; example validates metadata and replicate counts; converter validates its input.

maintainability.note: SKILL + usage-guide + runnable example with self-assertions + converter; blocks extract cleanly and run verbatim; sections mix provenance ('audit:') into instructions.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger; example and converter are true scripts; stop conditions (replicates, zero switches, missing annotators) present; no references/ split at 491 lines; n=2 caution missing.

recommendations.title: Raw-count route and n=2 presented without a null
recommendations.problem: On real chrX 2v2, the two mixed-population label splits called 11 and 15 genes with the raw route (true split 20; 1 of 20 shared), while the default route gave 0 in every split. The Skill says the default 'lost every call' so raw is used, and calls n=2 only 'underpowered'.
recommendations.root_cause: The 26-v-0 comparison has no permutation baseline, so it cannot say which route is right, and n=2 individual-level variation is not mentioned.
recommendations.fix: Add the label-permutation result to the Count route section, say n=2 calls are exploratory and can be anti-conservative, and recommend a label-shuffle sanity run and >=3 replicates before trusting either route.

recommendations.title: Block's sample-ID check is opaque
recommendations.problem: A metadata row missing from the quantification stops with 'setequal(ids, meta$sample_id) is not TRUE' and names no sample; the shipped example names them.
recommendations.root_cause: The SKILL.md block uses bare stopifnot() while the example carries the informative check.
recommendations.fix: Reuse the example's stop() message (only in quant / only in metadata) in the block.

recommendations.title: Preprint attribution and covariate mechanism
recommendations.problem: The Skill says the 2025 preprint 'describes an auto-selecting DTU wrapper and long-read/single-cell modes'; the bioRxiv abstract says only that the standard workflow suits long-read and single-cell data. The covariate-adjusted dIF is 'not traced', but installed NEWS and formals show importRdata(detectUnwantedEffects = TRUE) and covariate correction of IF.
recommendations.root_cause: Claims about a source and a package mechanism were written without checking either.
recommendations.fix: Cite the abstract's actual wording, and replace 'not traced in the source' with the NEWS statement and the detectUnwantedEffects argument.

recommendations.title: Small numeric mismatches and provenance text inside the Skill
recommendations.problem: Specificity after analyzeORF('longest') is 0.95 here (Skill 0.89); the factor range 0.019-205 is 0.019-576 with EffectiveLength (0.023-18 with Length); the dmFilter message is quoted without its 'min_samps_gene_expr >= 0 &&' clause; the Skill quotes 'the audit' inside instructions.
recommendations.root_cause: Numbers copied from one run and provenance left in the prose.
recommendations.fix: Correct or drop the figures, name which length was used, and move 'audit' wording out of SKILL.md.

recommendations.title: SKILL.md is 491 lines in one file
recommendations.problem: The Skill loads about 9-10k tokens whole; the count-route table, consequence order and Common Errors could load on demand.
recommendations.root_cause: No references/ layer; the fix chose deduplication over a split.
recommendations.fix: Move Count route, Functional Consequence Annotation details and Common Errors into references/ and keep a pointer in SKILL.md.

recommendations.title: Licence-gated annotators still unrun
recommendations.problem: signal_peptide_identified, IDR_identified/IDR_type and isoform_topology were not exercised (SignalP, IUPred2A, NetSurfP-2, DeepTMHMM); the Skill labels them 'not run' or 'read from source'.
recommendations.fix: Keep the flags; add a smoke test when a licence is available.
